observed: CSRF protection is implemented and observed: state-changing requests (POST, PATCH, PUT, DELETE) to actor-scoped routes must carry an X-XSRF-TOKEN header matching the okr_csrf_token double-submit cookie, and a missing or mismatched token is rejected with HTTP 403 INVALID_CSRF_TOKEN before any upstream call. Read routes are intentionally POST-based and non-mutating, and are excluded from the CSRF requirement by contract. Origin validation is not implemented: spa-bff never reads the Origin or Referer request header to decide whether to accept a request, and no allowlisted-origin configuration exists anywhere in the package. The control is named for both mechanisms, so it is recorded as pending rather than passed.

since_capture.note: This is not a capture. The 'observed' text above records release-2026-09-14-bff and is left unedited; its statement that origin validation is not implemented is no longer true of the working tree.
since_capture.code_state: Origin enforcement now exists in the spa-web tier, because the browser never reaches spa-bff: spa-web/src/lib/origin-guard.ts is applied to POST /api/session/login, POST /api/session/logout and every non-GET/HEAD call through /api/backend/*. Sec-Fetch-Site decides when present (only same-origin and none pass); otherwise a present Origin must match the request host; with neither header the caller is not a browser and is allowed. It answers 403 INVALID_ORIGIN. The CSRF double-submit described above is unchanged and remains a second layer on actor-scoped routes.

Unit and local evidence only, not a capture of a deployed stack.
since_capture.not_released: The change is not in commit 8f13375 and not in the published release 6150b4ade9203a03fb2829155776d9aafec0f142 (checked 2026-09-29), so no released build exhibits it.
since_capture.limits: It is not an allowlist of extra origins. Scheme is not compared. spa-bff itself still reads neither header, so a caller who reaches the BFF directly is outside this control; the BFF is not exposed to the browser. Behaviour behind a real Nginx is untested.
